text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, February 7, 2018 Posted by admin on February 7th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include General Electric (GE). 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -110 points. 
Tuesday the Dow was up +567.02 (+2.33%) at 24,912.77. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.78%. 
There were 26 Dow stocks up Tuesday. 
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by DowDupont (DWDP) +5.97% and Home Depot (HD) +4.33%. 
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) -1.72% and Merck (MRK) -1.67%. 
Walt Disney (DIS +1.40%) rose over 2% in after-hours trading after it reported Q1 adjusted EPS of $1.89, better than consensus of $1.61. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.605 per gallon.
